Todo muy organizado es autoservicio, lugar limpio, baños impecables, atención buena, si sos socio del ACA te hacen un descuento, las promociones son abundantes, lugar hiperventilado, luminoso con buena vista a la AVDA. RIVADAVIA.
OPINIÓN RECOMENDABLE,   TIENE ESTACIONAMIENTO. ME REFIERO AL ACA FLORES TOTALMENTE RENOVADO.

Everything is very well organized, it's self-service, the place is clean, the restrooms are spotless, the service is good, and if you're an ACA member you get a discount. There are plenty of promotions, and the place is well-ventilated, bright, and has a good view of Rivadavia Avenue.
Highly recommended. It has parking. I'm referring to the completely renovated ACA Flores.
